## Outcome

Describe the user-observable or foundation outcome and link its approved implementation packet.

## Evidence

- [ ] Acceptance criteria and relevant tests pass.
- [ ] No credentials, raw contributions, or private moderation data are included.
- [ ] Authority documents and ADRs are updated when a durable decision changed.
- [ ] Loading, empty-pool, offline, timeout, abandonment, and error states were considered.
- [ ] Abuse, reporting, blocking, leaving, and privacy effects were considered.

For a user-observable client change:

- [ ] Compact, medium, and expanded compositions were verified.
- [ ] Touch, keyboard, pointer, focus, text scaling, and reduced motion were verified.
- [ ] Resizing preserves active state, draft, focus intent, and scroll intent.
- [ ] Profile/release performance evidence is attached for affected journeys.
- [ ] Analytics contain structural events only, never raw human thought content.

If an item is not applicable, explain why rather than checking it silently.
